areas.disposition: Apply six cross-area cases to all alternatives; do not optimize isolated counters
areas.unresolved: Revision/cache/consultation, Stop/remote and plugin/update coupling can invalidate local wins.

cross_area_cases.trigger: A revocation races cached continuation, advice and child spawn. Include classifier-conversation compaction as a source-informed case.
cross_area_cases.required_outcome: New effects are fenced; cached/late advice cannot restore revoked authority; replay preserves the revision.

cross_area_cases.trigger: A slow/disconnected view competes for input while Stop and a remote completion cross. Include retained queues after abort and redirect-to-background behavior.
cross_area_cases.required_outcome: Views do not own execution; controls remain responsive; accepted/delivered/settled/unknown outcomes stay distinct.

cross_area_cases.trigger: Auxiliary quota becomes unavailable during specialist consultation and resume.
cross_area_cases.required_outcome: Every helper is accounted; no hidden API route or renewed reservation; intent and verification evidence survive.

cross_area_cases.trigger: Plugin/MCP revision or browser target changes during update and compatible rollback. Include a host that programmatically answers an approval request.
cross_area_cases.required_outcome: Report capability loss; no stale grant; newest work is preserved separately from executable restoration.

cross_area_cases.trigger: Compaction/checkpoint coincides with a replay gap, disk pressure and reconnect.
cross_area_cases.required_outcome: Canonical history, operation identity, cache invalidation and visible uncertainty stay coherent.

cross_area_cases.trigger: An installed but disabled capability is activated under a named revision.
cross_area_cases.required_outcome: Inactive work is bounded and measured; activation preserves required behavior and explicit eligibility/grants.
